rci1_using_msad.detail: UK Biobank imaging data is collected from multiple assessment centres across the UK; however, the paper treats UKB as a single batch in NeuroCombat harmonisation
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "Data from a total of 39,664 subjects (18,718 female) aged 44-82 were obtained from the UKB (application number 65299)" ; "we modelled 58 batches (UKB data as one batch and 57 ADNI sites as separate batches)"
rci1_using_msad.location: Janahi2022.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Datasets, L218-L220

rci2_using_epd.detail: UK Biobank used as the sole reference cohort for normative model (nomogram) training
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "Using imaging data from 35,686 healthy subjects aged 44-82 from the UK Biobank (UKB), we built HV nomograms using Gaussian process regression (GPR)"

rci3_epd_name.detail: UK Biobank (application number 65299) used for normative model training; ADNI was used only as an external test/application dataset
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "The UKB dataset was used to train the models and the ADNI dataset was used to test them."
rci3_epd_name.location: Janahi2022.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Gaussian process regression, L234

rci5_n.detail: Training phase; 39,664 initial UKB subjects minus 453 (medical conditions), 3,497 (genetic ancestry), and 28 (outliers); separate GPR models trained by sex for left, right, and bilateral HV from this cohort
rci5_n.supporting_text: "In the UKB sample, 453 subjects were excluded for various conditions, 3497 for genetic ancestry, and 28 subjects were outliers: leaving a total of 35,686 subjects."

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; sex breakdown after exclusions not reported; pre-exclusion sample had 18,718 female out of 39,664 total (47.2% female)
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "Data from a total of 39,664 subjects (18,718 female) aged 44-82 were obtained from the UKB"
rci6_sex.location: Janahi2022.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Datasets, L218

rci7_age.detail: Training phase; age range from Results section (training dataset age range 45-82); dataset description states aged 44-82 before exclusions; mean and SD not reported; age in years
rci7_age.supporting_text: "GPR nomograms spanned the entire training dataset age range (45-82 years)" ; "Data from a total of 39,664 subjects (18,718 female) aged 44-82 were obtained from the UKB"
